name: dev-bother-me-nope
description: Zero-question build pipeline: one long story in, merged-to-dev code plus a report out, then it stops. Any UI is designed first in Claude Design and Jonathan picks one direction; after that nothing is asked. Splits the story into stories, plans each, builds them with TDD using the right python skill set, merges to dev and tests (pytest plus headless Playwright), then runs exactly code → review → fix → review → report: one code review of everything the run implemented, one fix round (each finding reproduced as a failing test first, then merged to dev and tested), and one re-review of the fixes whose findings are reported, never fixed. Then it reports, alerts and is done; further work is a new goal only Jonathan decides. Never deploys to Vercel (not even dev). Merges to dev never build. Migrations go to the Supabase DEV database only; MAIN waits for Jonathan. A deploy-guard hook enforces this while a run is active. Merges are merge commits only, never squash: every merged branch is deleted with every worktree that has it checked out, locally and on origin, and every PR merge deletes its source branch.
